howto.what: Claude 在写 Bash 脚本时，会使用 #!/usr/bin/env bash 作为 shebang，设置 set -euo pipefail，保持脚本简洁，仅做最小输入验证，不检查已安装命令，并确保脚本可执行。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写 Bash 脚本、Shell 脚本或 CLI Bash 工具时触发。

say.text: 写一个 Bash 脚本，备份指定目录到 /backup。
say.note: 这会使脚本符合风格指南。

say.text: 帮我写一个 CLI 工具，用 curl 检查网站状态。

howto.what_en: When writing Bash scripts, Claude uses #!/usr/bin/env bash shebang, sets set -euo pipefail, keeps scripts minimal with no unnecessary comments or echoes, does minimal input validation, doesn't check for installed commands if failure is obvious, and makes scripts executable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to write a Bash script, shell script, or CLI Bash tool.

say_en.text: Write a Bash script to backup a directory to /backup.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a script following the style guide.

say_en.text: Create a CLI tool that checks website status using curl.
say_en.note: The script will be concise and safe.
